key_insight: A SCAPS-1D + machine-learning workflow can rapidly rank multilayer perovskite solar cell stacks and pinpoint high-efficiency, lead-free architectures.
engineering_relevance: The study provides practical design rules for selecting ETL, absorber, and HTL combinations to improve perovskite solar-cell efficiency while reducing exhaustive trial-and-error screening.
method: Trained an ML model on a representative subset to predict PCE for unseen stacks.
Used SHAP to identify the most important descriptors and verify top candidates with full device simulations.
evidence_signal: Leave-One-Group-Out cross-validation showed strong rank-correlation performance, and the top predicted devices achieved up to 28.85% PCE in SCAPS-1D.
watch_item: The ML predictions depend on the quality and coverage of the simulated training space, so extrapolation beyond the explored material set may be unreliable.
paper_title: Multilayer Screening of Double and Conventional Perovskite Solar Cells Using SCAPS-1D and Machine Learning: Optimization of ETL, HTL, and Absorber for High-Efficiency Architectures
